source.other: You can see the number of wares traded at any time in the general statistics menu. Good luck!

target.other: I menyn för allmän statistik kan du när som helst se antalet handlade varor. Lycka till!

key: You can see the number of wares traded at any time in the general statistics menu. Good luck!

source.other: Remember that the map has rotational symmetry. For example, when you have found a spot to the top-left of your headquarters, the corresponding spot will be to the bottom-right of the headquarters of your team mate.

target.other: Kom ihåg att kartan har rotationssymmetri. När du till exempel har hittat en plats uppe till vänster om ditt högkvarter ligger den motsvarande platsen nere till höger om din lagkamrats högkvarter.

key: Remember that the map has rotational symmetry. For example, when you have found a spot to the top-left of your headquarters, the corresponding spot will be to the bottom-right of the headquarters of your team mate.

source.other: The smuggling route worth %1$s from %2$s to %3$s has been broken!

target.other: Smugglingsrutten från %2$s till %3$s, som är värd %1$s, har brutits!

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: the first parameter is '<number> points', the last 2 parameters are player names
key: The smuggling route worth %1$s from %2$s to %3$s has been broken!

source.other: Your team has established a new smuggling route. You have the receiving warehouse. Every ware smuggled here is worth %s.

target.other: Ditt lag har etablerat en ny smugglingsrutt. Du har den mottagande lagerbyggnaden. Varje vara som smugglas här är värd %s.

key: Your team has established a new smuggling route. You have the receiving warehouse. Every ware smuggled here is worth %s.

source.other: Your team has established a new smuggling route. You have the sending warehouse. Every ware smuggled here is worth %s.

target.other: Ditt lag har etablerat en ny smugglingsrutt. Du har den avsändande lagerbyggnaden. Varje vara som smugglas här är värd %s.

key: Your team has established a new smuggling route. You have the sending warehouse. Every ware smuggled here is worth %s.

source.other: For harder to defend smuggling routes, you get 2 or 3 points per ware smuggled. The first team to collect %s wins.

target.other: För smugglingsrutter som är svårare att försvara får du två eller tre poäng per smugglad vara. Det lag som först samlar ihop %s vinner.

key: For harder to defend smuggling routes, you get 2 or 3 points per ware smuggled. The first team to collect %s wins.

source.other: Smugglers is a fun map for 4 players. You and your partner start diagonally from each other on a point symmetric island. There are plenty of smuggling tunnels on this island, each consisting of a receiving and a sending end.

target.other: Smugglare är en rolig karta för fyra spelare. Du och din medspelare börjar diagonalt mitt emot varandra på en punktsymmetrisk ö. Det finns gott om smugglingstunnlar på ön, var och en med en mottagarände och en sändarände.

key: Smugglers is a fun map for 4 players. You and your partner start diagonally from each other on a point symmetric island. There are plenty of smuggling tunnels on this island, each consisting of a receiving and a sending end.

source.other: A new smuggling route from %1$s to %2$s has been established! Every ware they smuggle there is worth %3$s.

target.other: En ny smugglingsrutt från %1$s till %2$s har etablerats! Varje vara som smugglas där är värd %3$s.

developer_comment: TRANSLATORS: the first 2 parameters are player names, the last parameter is '<number> points'
key: A new smuggling route from %1$s to %2$s has been established! Every ware they smuggle there is worth %3$s.

source.other: To establish a smuggling route, you need to build a warehouse on a sending/receiving spot while your team mate has to build one on the corresponding receiving/sending spot. A ware is then transported every 10 seconds.

target.other: För att upprätta en smugglingsrutt måste du bygga en lagerbyggnad på en sändar-/mottagarplats, medan din lagkamrat bygger en på den motsvarande mottagar-/sändarplatsen. Därefter transporteras en vara var tionde sekund.

key: To establish a smuggling route, you need to build a warehouse on a sending/receiving spot while your team mate has to build one on the corresponding receiving/sending spot. A ware is then transported every 10 seconds.

source.other: Game over! %1$s and %2$s have won the game! %3$s and %4$s only managed to collect %5$s.

target.other: Spelet är slut! %1$s och %2$s har vunnit spelet! %3$s och %4$s lyckades bara samla ihop %5$s.
